notes: Version 2.28 synchronises the PRS 3.0 / A4-Note 3.0 source contract and its consumers (Q14 3.1, EBJ 2.1, PYO 2.1, PYL 3.0.1, AAR 1.3, Q11OF 1.1, CHO 1.1, AOG-Note 1.8, KUD 1.5, TPC 1.2, NPI 1.0.1, FM-Note 3.1), with statuses typed per result. PRS: the compression remainder of the projected Dirac square is the Schur complement -N^dagger N <= 0 under a contraction and a symbol condition, equal to the projective endomorphism of Q14 only when Pi_S D^2 Pi_S^* = Lich; under [H-Gen] a J_Pi-commuting locking operator gives u = 0; the Schur-null and Schur-transverse loci form a dichotomy proved under explicit hypotheses, which locus holds being open ([H-Tr]); no mechanism for a non-zero split is derived. A4-Note: the quartic coefficient of the radicand is chart-dependent and selects no lock, the Lorentzian genus is not determined, and the Front D factorisation is formal. EBJ: the finite witness has J^2 = +1 and lies outside [H-Gen](i). Q14 3.1 states E_Pi <= 0 as an explicit hypothesis. [gamma_5, R_b] = 0 is the hypothesis [H-WS] of Q11OF (scalar -1 on the chiral carrier); the J_3 signal comes from the sl2 commutator [E,F] = H, not from the Heisenberg bracket. The inventory, dependency figure, bibliography and interactive graph carry these statements; PRS and the A4-Note are typed conditional and the edges PRS to A4-Note and A4-Note to EBJ are typed conditional.
